notes.title: Art Update 3
notes.notes:
[b][i]Hey, it's been a while! Blackout is back and with its biggest update ever. Art Update #3 contains the biggest overhauls done to Blackout's UI, Settings, and Technical Components with some Quality of Life and Optimization fixes thrown in as well. [/i][/b]

[url=#UI]UI/Menu Changes[/url] | [url=#TU]Tech Upgrades[/url] | [url=#EX]Extras[/url] | [url=#NU]Next Update[/url]

[h2=UI][b]UI/Menu Changes:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]New Main Menu[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849581/be566be79eedc7eb6fb38635a5a4b2e917da7434.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Main Menu is now Physics-Based (besides some scripted events for lore reasons)
[*] New Ability Reroll System
[*] Updated Card Textures & Models
[*] Updated General Lighting
[*] Updated Landscape & Background
[*] Changed Splash Screen (placeholder till next update)
[*] Updated Card & Camera Animations 
[*] Updated SFX (placeholder till next update) [/list]

[h3][b]New Settings Menu[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849581/841070f76179c63c8e80a5f895afeb7039350498.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New Settings Menu including settings for Video, Audio, Keybinds, and General settings
[*] Settings now save between game instances
[*] Added 13 New Graphics Settings
[*] Added 8 New General Settings
[*] Added 1 New Audio Setting
[*] Added ability to remap any Keybind [/list]

[h3][b]New Player HUD[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849581/1183f3d15a1397a910919398c26d1d8c4e293f8d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Rewritten from scratch for better performance
[*] Updated Player HUD with new Ability Card Textures and Animations
[*] Updated Weapon Cards with new Textures and Animations 
[*] Player HUD now reacts with certain in-game interactions (Fortune Teller, Arsenal Ascender, & more) 
[*] Player Crosshair Color can now be changed in the Settings Menu 
[*] Updated SFX for various HUD Updates 
[*] Keybinds on the PlayerHUD now update in realtime when a key bind change is made [/list]


[h2=TU][b]Tech Upgrades:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]New Input System[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849581/6808a95eca2a9f484db46068e454c94b34d4e053.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New Input System built from scratch
[*] Keybinds can now be remapped to any key through the Settings Menu
[*] Enhanced Performance with Interactable Objects in-game
[*] New options during player clicks allow for more in-depth mechanics (Grenade Projectile Prediction Path, Grenade Instant Throw, & more) [/list]

[h3][b]Rebuilt Menus[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849581/1a23493572ffbf13b620722c40e507c30b386f64.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Most Menus were rebuilt from scratch to have better performance and be easier to develop. 
[*] Includes New Main Menu, Settings Menu, PlayerHUD, & Stats Screen [/list]

[h3][b]New Grenade[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849581/6f8bd62ecce6abe2e493dea31f374f867fdeb249.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Grenade Functionality rewritten from scratch for better performance and features 
[*] After holding down the Grenade Button for a few frames, a prediction path will be visible to show the arch of the Grenade before launch
[*] Grenades no longer get blocked by invisible walls 
[*] Grenade Origin location is now bound to the Player Camera (aka Grenade Origin is now consistent)
[*] Grenade Lifespan increased to 20 seconds
[*] Reduced Grenade hitbox to fit into smaller gaps (does not affect explosion radius) 
[*] Grenades no longer launch on button click, now on button release by default
[*] Added Setting called "Insta-Grenade Throw" in Settings Menu to revert new on button release functionality [/list]

[h2=EX][b]Extras:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Ritual Lantern Updates[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849581/56cbffa79c913977c76912353614a203a1f1d30c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Lanterns at Temple Top are now Reactive to Top Ritual
[*] Added Lanterns to Final Gate for each one of the Rituals, each one lights up when a Ritual is completed
[*] Final Gate is now bound to completing all Rituals rather than unlocking all Fountain Gates [/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several immortal/glitch spots in the Shipwreck Area
[*] Fixed Infinite Damage exploit with AB1-BoostedMag (hopefully)
[*] Adjusted volume of Shotgun fire to match other Audio (all tiers) 
[*] Added new Out-of-Bounds Terrain in Shipwreck area 
[*] Removed more out-of-bounds objects from the Navigation Mesh calculations
[*] Fixed Ritual Zone Symbols from being two-sided when off [/list]

[h2=NU][b]Next Update:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Next Update is Blackout's Full Release Update. This includes everything the game needs to be considered complete to exit out of Early Access and into Full Release. 
[*] Perktronix & Arsenal Ascender updates were delayed till the next update since they were more about gameplay changes rather than just art/optimization. 
[*] Finalizations to most Menus & Systems
[*] More General QoL Changes and Optimizations [/list]

[i]Update & Post made by: [url=https://www.vojmir.com/]Vojmir[/url]

notes.title: Blackout - Early Access is now Public!
notes.notes:
[h3][u][b]But now what?[/b][/u][/h3]

Firstly, we'd like to thank all of the [url=https://discord.gg/KmdVzjxmTy]Playtesting Community[/url] for aiding us in the creation of this game, without you we wouldn't be anywhere near where we are today.

[h2][b][u]Past, Present, and Future[/u][/b][/h2]
Blackout has been in development since April 2023 and was worked on by a team of 5 Designers until July 2023 with 3 Artists & 2 Audio Producers joining us on our final month. This game was our College Capstone Project where we had 4 months to make a game and post regular updates to our [url=https://vojmir.itch.io/blackout]Itch.io Page[/url], and the initial goal was to leave it on there with maybe a possible Steam Release happening in the future.

Since then, all of the team has graduated and mostly all moved on from the project for various reasons. So why/how is this game still getting updates? 

The game was picked back up by one of the original designers in January 2024 and began active development again for a Steam Release for Portfolio reasons, that designer being me the person writing this post: [url=https://www.vojmir.com/]Hello[/url]. So currently the project only has one active developer. The game has received 3 updates since being initially put onto Steam, you can see community posts about those here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2461070/view/4022345969718475704?l=english
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2461070/view/3964924274910975790?l=english
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2461070/view/3964924274909653665?l=english

[h3][b][u]What's next?[/u][/b][/h3]
Blackout is currently going through what I like to call its "Art Phase" which means the next couple of updates will be solely focused on improving the Textures, Animations, SFX, VFX, Lighting, etc. of the game to leave behind the "In-Dev" look it currently has and showcase why the game is called "Blackout" (yes there is a reason!).

This isn't to say that the only updates to come will be Art related. There is one more Content Update planned with a couple of new End-Game features, mechanics, interactables, and more but this will be after the Art updates are done. 

After that, there will be the Full Release Update which will be the last and final update to the game transitioning it from Early Access to Full Release as there is nothing more planned for this Project since it's mainly a Portfolio Piece for our Team. Moving on to other projects would be the most beneficial thing for us in terms of building up our Portfolios.

[h3][b][u]That's all Folks![/u][/b][/h3]
Thank you for checking out this project and this community post, I'm sure almost no one reads these but still want to keep those who check these out updated!

[i]Update & Post made by: [url=https://www.vojmir.com/]Vojmir[/url][/i]
